verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a YAML API spec (docs.jumpcloud.com/api/2.0/index.yaml) and a GitHub repo of API example scripts. Neither shows an interactive API reference where examples can be run in place, such as a try-it console. The spec and scripts are adjacent material, not the capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
